title: terminalia chebula var. tomentella
intro: Terminalia chebula var. tomentella, commonly known as the Himalayan chebula or wild chebula, is a plant species belonging to the Combretaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Terminalia chebula var. tomentella are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, exhibit hepatoprotective and nephroprotective effects, and possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
